A '''zombie''' is a common undead {{MCD2|mob}} found throughout the {{MCD2|Overworld}}.

== Spawning ==
* {{MCD2Link|id=Deep Dark|The Deep Dark}}
* {{MCD2Link|Frozen Highlands}}
* {{MCD2Link|Howling Woods}}

== Behavior ==
Zombies slowly walk toward {{MCD2|hero}}es and swing at them.

Zombies come in three tiers, with the first tier lacking any equipment. The second tier wields a dagger and rusted iron armor, while the third tier has oxidized copper armor and a {{MCD2|sword}}. Higher tier zombies deal more damage, have more health, and are physically larger.
